title: Coefficient and integer triangles for the coherent inverse-image square
statement: Let g:Y→X be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], F and G quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent], ψ:g*F→G, and θ:F_et→g_*G_et with components prescribed by qcoherentPullbackSection [lem-weil-pbc-qcoherent-pullback-sections-map]. Write Z for the exact inverse image of Zariski abelian sheaves and E for etale inverse image [def-pbc-qcoherent-zariski-cohomology-map, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Let z:S_Y→Z(S_X) and e:T_Y→E(T_X) be the canonical constant-integer comparisons. Let f:Z(F_ab)→G_ab be adjoint to the underlying abelian h-map of ψ, and t:E(F_et)→G_et adjoint to θ. There exist exact comparison presentations D_X,D_Y [def-pbc-coherent-etale-exact-comparison] and an isomorphism τ:P_X⋙E≅Z⋙P_Y satisfying e·E(b_X)·τ(S_X)=b_Y·P_Y(z) and τ(F_ab)·P_Y(f)·d_G=E(d_F)·t. This asserts only a square of exact functors and two equations of sheaf morphisms; it contains no positive-degree cohomology classes or arbitrary normalized equivalences.

proof.text: Construct P on each scheme from the exact inverse image of the inclusion of open subschemes into the etale site, after coefficient ULift. The adjoint of the tensor-section identification on opens supplies d, and the constant integer generator under the adjunction unit supplies b. Tensor unit naturality gives the coefficient naturality and section equation in ExactComparison.

Base change identifies the open subscheme U×_X Y with the inverse-image open g⁻¹U. Thus the square of direct-image functors commutes canonically. Uniqueness of left adjoints and the commuting comparison with coefficient ULift give τ. The composition law for adjunction units, on the integer generator, gives the first triangle.

Take the adjoints of the second triangle and evaluate on open objects. The tensor composition-unit law expresses its component as qcoherentPullbackSection. The component hypothesis on θ identifies these components, and injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalences proves the triangle. No flatness of g is required.

theorem exists_coherentEtale_inverseImage_square
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent] (ψ : (tensorPullback g).obj F ⟶ G)
    (θ : liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F ⟶
      (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf G))
    (hθ : ∀ (U : X.Etale) (s : (etaleTensorSectionsSheaf F).obj.obj (op U)),
      θ.hom.app (op U) (ULift.up s) = ULift.up
        (qcoherentPullbackSection g F G ψ U
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ⊤ g).obj U)
          (pullback.fst U.hom g) pullback.condition s)) :
    let J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X
    let K := Opens.grothendieckTopology Y
    let Z := (Opens.map g.base).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u} J K
    let z := ((Opens.map g.base).constantSheafsheafPullbackIso AddCommGrpCat.{u} J K
      isTerminalTop isTerminalTop).symm.app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
    let φ := (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).homEquiv F G ψ
    let f := (((Opens.map g.base).sheafAdjunctionContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} J K).homEquiv
      _ _).symm (moduleAbelianHMap g φ)
    let E := Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g
    let e := (Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).symm.app
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
    let t := ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).homEquiv
      (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F) (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf G)).symm θ
    ∃ (D₁ : CoherentEtale.ExactComparison X) (D₂ : CoherentEtale.ExactComparison Y)
      (τ : D₁.P ⋙ E ≅ Z ⋙ D₂.P),
      e.hom ≫ E.map D₁.integer ≫ τ.hom.app (CoherentEtale.zariskiInteger X) =
        D₂.integer ≫ D₂.P.map z.hom ∧
      τ.hom.app ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) ≫
          D₂.P.map f ≫ D₂.coefficient G = E.map (D₁.coefficient F) ≫ t
